description: Replaces one clip's footage with a choice returned by huasheng_list_footage_candidates. Pass choice exactly as returned — never pass the visible position because the list can reorder after a swap. If the receipt is not terminal, track its operation.id with huasheng_wait_for_action instead of repeating this write.

choice.description: Candidate choice copied exactly from the list tool — or the user's own footage: a path to an .mp4/.mov/.jpg/.png on this machine, or a public http(s) address (uploaded for free, then applied)

client_action_id.description: MCP App only: submission id; reuse for the same click. Models omit.

expected_revision.description: Reject if the clip has changed since this revision.

from.description: The same candidate source used when listing, default agent

pid.description: Video id (15 digits); default: this machine's current video.

ui_lang.description: MCP App only: follow-up language. Models omit.

wait_s.description: Seconds to wait for the replacement to land, up to 30; default 0

name: huasheng_replace_clip_footage

client_action_id.description: App-supplied id; repeats reuse the first result

args.description: Arguments to merge the chosen choice into

tool.description: The tool the card calls with the chosen candidate

action.description: When listing: how the card submits a choice. After a swap: the authoritative receipt

applied.description: After a swap: whether it has landed. **false is not a failure** — it is still assembling

as_of.description: When this snapshot was taken, ISO 8601. The card shows it in its header

choice.description: Pass this back as choice, exactly as given

in_use.description: The clip is already using this one

pending.description: The newly selected footage is still being assembled

playback_rate.description: How the footage meets the narration length — **not** a quality signal. Above 1 means the footage is longer and the extra is **trimmed**; it still plays at normal speed. Below 1 means Huasheng slows it down to fill the narration. Only worth mentioning below about 0.6, where the slow motion becomes visible

position.description: Where it sits in this list, counting from 1

selected.description: After a replacement: this is the newly selected footage

used_by_clip.description: Another clip already uses it; absent when nothing does

was_in_use.description: After a replacement: this was the footage in use before the change

clip.description: Which clip these belong to, counting from 1

need_s.description: How long the narration runs. Footage shorter than this is **not** a problem — it is slowed down to fit; see playback_rate on each candidate

query.description: What Huasheng searched for. If nothing fits, this is usually why

revision.description: Pass back as expected_revision when choosing from this candidate set

submitted.description: After a swap: this candidate card is a frozen record of the completed selection, not a fresh picker

url.description: Link to the video in Huasheng

title: Replace the footage on one clip
